verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both put 'WORLD'S' below 'Biggest Plants', which breaks the headline's reading order. Both shrink the industrial tower photo to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the bottom-left corner with the dots, and leave large dead gaps above and below the cooling-tower photo. The thin rule loses its role as the WORLD'S accent line. B is only marginally cleaner: its short rule sits clear of the top dot cluster, while A's rule runs into the dots.
